facts: Daily order handling capacity is the estimated maximum order volume a shop can efficiently dispatch in one day.
Capacity-setting changes take effect the next day.
Eligible excess volume may receive automatic timing extensions, while volume above three times capacity may trigger surge protection.
The new Logistics and Fulfillment Score was preview-only through October 14, 2026 and scheduled to launch October 15.
WEM adds a bottleneck model, recovery buffer, trigger ladder and daily capacity cadence.
